lists.name: France: telemarketing prefixes
lists.description: The 12 ranges (0162, 0163, 0270, 0271, 0377, 0378, 0424, 0425, 0568, 0569, 0948, 0949) reported as assigned to telemarketing platforms.
lists.caution: Telemarketing was banned in France on 11 August 2026 and the ranges may change.

lists.name: Begone FR: telemarketing
lists.description: The same 12 telemarketing ranges, from the Begone France lists.

lists.name: Begone FR: VoIP operators
lists.description: Number blocks of internet-telephony operators often used by call centres (Destiny, BJT Partners, OnOff, Aircall, Ubicentrex and others).
lists.caution: Blocks every number of these operators, including legitimate businesses that use them.

lists.name: Begone FR: prepaid mobile
lists.description: Mobile numbers of a prepaid operator (Lyca).
lists.caution: Blocks all of this operator's customers, including real people who call you.

lists.name: Begone FR: everything
lists.description: Telemarketing, VoIP and prepaid lists combined.
lists.caution: Very broad: it also blocks legitimate callers on the VoIP and prepaid ranges.

lists.name: Switzerland: telemarketing ranges
lists.description: Number ranges where many telemarketing numbers are seen, plus single numbers outside them. Built from local.ch's list of verified telemarketing numbers.
lists.caution: Blocks whole ranges, so it can also block a few real numbers inside them.

lists.name: Switzerland: listed telemarketing numbers
lists.description: Exactly the numbers listed as telemarketing on local.ch, with no ranges.

lists.name: Spain: spam and scam numbers
lists.description: Numbers reported for commercial spam, scams and phishing in Spain, collected from public spam-reporting sites.
lists.caution: The maintainer says it includes some legitimate telecom and delivery companies, and blocks some ranges resold for spam.
